headline: DGHS summons Shyamoli hospital authorities over child's death
summary: A 4-month-old baby died at a private hospital in Dhaka's Shyamoli; the father alleges an oxygen line leakage caused the tragedy.
details: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) has summoned the authorities of Shyamoli Baby Care and General Hospital following the death of a 4-month-old child.
The child died on Tuesday evening around 6:30 pm. The father, Md Faruq, alleges that an oxygen line leakage at the facility caused the death, claiming the child was recovering before the accident.
Hospital authorities have denied the allegation, stating the child's physical condition had been deteriorating since the afternoon and died due to complications from measles.
According to the hospital, five other admitted children were transferred to another facility upstairs during the leakage incident on Tuesday.
DGHS Director Abu Hussain Md Moinul Ahsan confirmed that the health directorate will record statements from the hospital authorities on Thursday to decide the facility's fate.
caption:
A 4-month-old baby died in a Dhaka hospital. The father alleges a fatal oxygen leak, while the hospital blames measles complications.

The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) has summoned the authorities of Shyamoli Baby Care and General Hospital following the death of a 4-month-old child.

The child died on Tuesday evening around 6:30 pm. The father, Md Faruq, alleges that an oxygen line leakage at the facility caused the death, claiming the child was recovering before the accident.

Hospital authorities have denied the allegation, stating the child's physical condition had been deteriorating since the afternoon and died due to complications from measles.

According to the hospital, five other admitted children were transferred to another facility upstairs during the leakage incident on Tuesday.

DGHS Director Abu Hussain Md Moinul Ahsan confirmed that the health directorate will record statements from the hospital authorities on Thursday to decide the facility's fate.

headline_marked: Signal glitch: [[Three coaches of Bijoy Express derail]] near Gouripur
headline: Signal glitch: Three coaches of Bijoy Express derail near Gouripur
summary: A technical fault in the relay interlocking system disrupted rail communication between Mymensingh and Chattogram on Wednesday night.
details: Three coaches of the Bijoy Express derailed near the outer signal area of Gouripur Station around 10:45 PM on Wednesday.
The derailment occurred as the train departed Gouripur for Chattogram, causing the rear three coaches to detach and leave the tracks.
The remaining coaches also became separated from the locomotive, completely disrupting train movement on the route.
According to Golam Mawla, an RNB official at Mymensingh Station, the incident was caused by a fault in the computer-based relay interlocking system.
The system failure meant the line was not cleared properly, leading to the derailment.
Railway workers were rushed to the scene to begin recovery operations and restore the rail link between Mymensingh and Chattogram.
caption:
A 'signal glitch' derailed three coaches of the Bijoy Express, cutting off the rail link between Mymensingh and Chattogram.

Three coaches of the Bijoy Express derailed near the outer signal area of Gouripur Station around 10:45 PM on Wednesday.

The derailment occurred as the train departed Gouripur for Chattogram, causing the rear three coaches to detach and leave the tracks.

The remaining coaches also became separated from the locomotive, completely disrupting train movement on the route.

According to Golam Mawla, an RNB official at Mymensingh Station, the incident was caused by a fault in the computer-based relay interlocking system.

The system failure meant the line was not cleared properly, leading to the derailment.

Railway workers were rushed to the scene to begin recovery operations and restore the rail link between Mymensingh and Chattogram.
